0.original: Zukin knows the way to a Confederate's heart.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

24.original: Deliver the Kojin pickles to Confederates at the Coral Banquet.

48.original: The key to a man's heart is through his stomach, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. With this in mind, I would ask your help in maintaining an important partnership.

49.original: I have here two pots of our finest pickles, which I would gift to the sentries at the Coral Banquet. Pray see to it they are delivered.

50.original: You are far from home, adventurer. What business have you here?

51.original: Hah, if it isn't Kojin pickles! I had been looking forward to this! My thanks, friend!

52.original: Zukin has been sending us pickles on a regular basis. They bring much welcomed flavor to an otherwise bland day.

53.original: If you require something, please make it quick. I'm on patrol.

54.original: Well now, more pickles from the Kojin! There's been more contact between us of late, and I must say I appreciate these little gestures.

55.original: Please send them my thanks along with this message: should we turn up aught of note, they'll be the first to know.

56.original: Now, if you'll excuse me, I must be moving along.

57.original: You better have a good reason for distractin' me on watch! Might be as I drink hard, but I work hard as well! <hic>

58.original: Oh, shite, pickles from the Kojin!? You're a good sort, adventurer! A bloody good sort! <hic>

59.original: Let me tell you, these pickles and rice wine are a match made in heaven! Gah, this watch can't end soon enough! <hic>

60.original: Oh, I know─I'll move quicker! That way the watch'll end sooner! Haha, what a bloody brilliant idea! <hic>

61.original: Delivered the pickles, have you? Tell me, how did our Confederate friends respond?

62.original: ...So we continue to be held in good standing. That is well. A little kindness indeed goes a long way.

63.original: In the past, we Kojin would purchase such treasures as the Confederacy seized in lieu of the Ruby Tithe. By maintaining amicable relations, we have first pick of the merchandise. A fine arrangement, I'm sure you'll agree.
